name: genpark-agentic-travel-multi-leg-itinerary-synthesizer-skill
description: Universal Agentic Travel & Multi-Leg Hospitality Itinerary Synthesizer (inspired by Meta Muse, Expedia, Booking). Translates natural language vacation and business travel goals into multi-leg flight segments, lodging selection, layover time buffers, baggage fee optimization, and consolidated reservation manifests.

tools.name: synthesize_travel_itinerary
tools.description: Multi-leg travel synthesis: plan flight segments, evaluate hotel bookings, calculate layover buffer risks, optimize baggage fees, and assemble unified booking manifests.

origin.description: Origin airport code (e.g. SFO, PEK, LHR).

destination.description: Destination airport code (e.g. HND, JFK, CDG).

budget_usd.description: Total target travel budget in USD.

layover_minutes.description: Layover duration in minutes for risk evaluation.
